findings.value: An Idea Store branch on Whitechapel Road, in a modern building in Whitechapel market, that hosts meetings, training, conferences and social events.

evidence.quote: Idea Store Whitechapel can cater for a variety of corporate and social activities ranging from meetings, seminars, conferences, training, interviews, dance rehearsals and hospitality events housed in a modern architectural building.
Based in the busy Whitechapel market in front of Sainsbury

notes: Council hire page only. The council events calendar lead has a date but no description, and its own site pages tried had no readable description. One WebSearch found no press or review. No status news.
